decisions.reason: It remained visible in 2024 as a product family, suggesting performance is at least near aspiration levels and the firm has enough portfolio slack to continue a coordinated architectural range.
Its upgrade to a dedicated 2024 page signals management attention and acceptable early results, so behavioral-theory logic points to retention rather than reallocating resources.
Although only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, its continued presence indicates results not poor enough to trigger problemistic search and dropping in this design-led hardware business.
A named collection with its own page in both 2023 and 2024 fits the firm's strategy of durable, coordinated product families and is therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
